--- a/DIAGNOSIS.json
+++ b/DIAGNOSIS.json
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+{
+  "candidate": "cand_0002",
+  "headline": "Escalate the hard-0 wrong-reservation cluster from a skippable read tool to an UNSKIPPABLE get_user_details return enrichment, and re-ship cand_0001's safe deterministic edits (get_price_quote, enriched booking error, update-tool amount returns, cancel-flown guard, execute-after-confirm policy) which the gate confirmed did no damage.",
+  "clusters": [
+    {"id": "A", "name": "Wrong-reservation targeting", "detail": "User names a trip by route with no reservation id; agent reads only opaque ids from get_user_details and writes to the first one (UM3OG5=SEA->DFW) instead of the matching one (FQ8APE=NY->ORD). cand_0001's find_reservations was skippable.", "tasks": ["17", "22"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
+    {"id": "B", "name": "Guessed/stale booking total", "detail": "Agent builds book_reservation payment from stale prices on an existing reservation (task 25: 299 vs live 375); book_reservation raises 'does not add up' and writes nothing.", "tasks": ["25", "23"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
+    {"id": "C", "name": "Hand-computed amount -> wrong COMMUNICATE", "detail": "DB write correct but agent states a hand-computed refund (5548 vs required 5244); engine computes the exact delta and discards it.", "tasks": ["11", "37"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
+    {"id": "D", "name": "Unauthorized cancel of a flown reservation", "detail": "Agent cancels NQNU5R whose segments (2024-05-13/14) already flew; policy forbids, API doesn't enforce.", "tasks": ["37"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
+    {"id": "E", "name": "Narrate-without-action after confirm/error", "detail": "After 'yes' the agent reports the change done / transfers without issuing the write; after an error it abandons rather than correcting.", "tasks": ["12", "37", "25", "23"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"}
+  ],
+  "edits": [
+    {"id": "E1", "title": "Enrich get_user_details to return per-reservation route/date summaries (reservations_detail)", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "Return is a superset of the old User dump built from reservation.origin/destination + per-segment O->D; DB grader reads DB not returns. Makes the matching reservation's route unavoidably visible on the always-called first read."},
+    {"id": "E2", "title": "Policy: identify the correct reservation by route, never default to the first id (worked example)", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Reinforces existing 'locate it using available tools'; adds city->airport mapping and an ask-if-ambiguous rule; flips no currently-correct decision."},
+    {"id": "E3", "title": "Add get_price_quote read tool (authoritative total from current prices)", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Reuses book_reservation pricing (price*pax + 50*bags + 30*pax insurance); returns total=375 for task-25 legs so the first split is correct. Additive, read-only, 15 tools total."},
+    {"id": "E4", "title": "Enrich book_reservation payment/not-found/low-balance errors with breakdown + next step", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B", "E"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "On a bad split prints total + flights/baggage/insurance breakdown + signed shortfall + 'don't reuse stored prices; re-call summing to EXACTLY N'. Only error text changes; passing calls never reach it."},
+    {"id": "E5", "title": "Return payment_delta/amount_charged/amount_refunded from update tools", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "DB mutation happens in place before the return, so DB grading is unchanged; delta 456-5700=-5244 => amount_refunded=5244 = task-11 gold communicate value."},
+    {"id": "E6", "title": "cancel_reservation flown/already-cancelled in-body guard", "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Blocks 37-t2 NQNU5R (segments 2024-05-13/14 < current 2024-05-15); confirmed silent on 19-t Z7GOZK (05-28) and 23-t K1NW8N (05-26/28), the passing cancels."},
+    {"id": "E7", "title": "Policy: execute-immediately-after-confirmation + recover-from-write-error contract", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT", "clusters": ["E"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE", "verified": "Tightening with WRONG/RIGHT examples; no passing task relied on narrating without acting. Secondary lever (prose-only; the field has rejected prose reminders for this class)."},
+    {"id": "E8", "title": "Policy: authoritative pricing (get_price_quote first, never stale prices, one-cert->split) + quote-returned-amount rules", "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["B", "C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Points the agent at get_price_quote before booking and at amount_refunded/amount_charged for reporting; adds the one-certificate-per-reservation split rule covering task 23's structural decomposition."}
+  ],
+  "skipped": [
+    {"title": "Task 40", "reason": "Documented tau2 user-simulator infra noise; instructed not to optimize against it."},
+    {"title": "Task 8-t2 duplicate-booking idempotency guard", "reason": "A general guard would have to guess 'same user+route+date = duplicate', unsupported by any other trace and could block legitimate repeat bookings."},
+    {"title": "Composite split-booking WRITE tool for 3-cert->3-reservation (task 23) and narrate-without-action (E)", "reason": "No code can force the agent to end its turn with a write; deferred to the prose contract this round. Switch to a composite WRITE tool if E/23 persist."}
+  ],
+  "techniques": ["parallel diagnostic subagents per cluster", "escalate a skippable read tool to an unskippable return enrichment on an always-called tool", "new read tool for a capability gap", "in-body eligibility guard verified against passing traces", "enriched actionable error text", "enriched return values surfacing engine-computed amounts", "policy worked examples for a mid-tier reader"]
+}
--- a/policy/policy.md
+++ b/policy/policy.md
@@ -6,4 +6,10 @@
 
 Before taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, changing cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
+
+**Execute immediately after the user confirms — do not just describe it.** The moment the user says "yes" / "go ahead" / approves, your VERY NEXT step MUST be the matching write tool call (`book_reservation`, `update_reservation_flights`, `update_reservation_baggages`, `update_reservation_passengers`, or `cancel_reservation`). Do NOT tell the user the change is "done", "processed", "completed", or "ready" until the write tool has actually returned. Do NOT transfer or end your turn after a confirmation without first issuing the write.
+- WRONG: user says "yes"; you reply "Your 2 bags have been added!" with no tool call. The database is unchanged and the task scores 0.
+- RIGHT: user says "yes"; your next action is the `update_reservation_baggages` tool call; only after it returns do you confirm to the user, quoting the amount from the tool's return.
+
+**Recover from a write error — never abandon it.** If a write tool returns an error (for example "Payment amount does not add up"), read the error text, fix the exact argument it names, and immediately re-issue the corrected write call in your next action. Do not report the change as done, and do not transfer or give up, just because the first call errored — the error
